# HRPro | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| Positioning | Integrated personnel and remuneration systems for Hong Kong companies, emphasizing local remuneration, MPF, taxation and optional AI support. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competing boundary | AI is described as “selected AI-assessed operations” and should not be equivalent to full process autonomy; compliance updates of SLA, cloud data location and upgrade costs need to be confirmed. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, prize or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | AI's description as “selected AI-assessed operations” should not be equivalent to full process autonomy; compliance updates of SLA, cloud data location and upgrade costs need to be identified. |
